title: SCHOOL PRESSURE

hook.kids: When school feels like too much.
hook.teens: When the workload stops being work and starts being your worth.

body.kids: Doing your best matters. Being the best is not what God asks of you.
body.teens: Grades measure work. They are not a measure of you, and the moment the two get welded together every result becomes a verdict on your worth. Work hard — then let the result be a result, not a sentence.

verse: Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.

step.kids: Tell a grown-up how much work you have.
step.teens: Name to one person the thing you are most behind on. Secrecy is what gives it weight.

title: ANXIETY

hook.teens: When your body is at rest and your head is not.

body.kids: Worry is not naughty. It is a feeling — and it is something you can hand to God, out loud.
body.teens: Anxiety is not a failure of faith; half the psalms are complaints. What Scripture asks is not that you stop feeling it but that you take it somewhere — specifically, to God and to people who can help carry it.

verse: Cast all your worries on him, because he cares for you.

step.kids: Say the worry out loud to someone today.
step.teens: Write the anxiety down, then mark the one part of it you can actually act on this week.

title: FRIENDSHIP

hook.kids: Being a good friend, and finding good friends.
hook.teens: Who you spend time with is who you are becoming.

body.kids: Good friends are kind when nobody is watching. Be that kind of friend.
body.teens: Friendship in Proverbs is measured by what survives trouble. Ask honestly whether your friendships make you braver and kinder, or just louder.

verse: A friend loves at all times.

step.kids: Include someone who is on their own today.
step.teens: Have one conversation this week that goes past the surface.

title: FAMILY

hook.kids: Families are great and hard, sometimes on the same day.
hook.teens: Loving people you did not choose and cannot leave.

body.kids: You will not always agree with your family. You can still be kind to them today.
body.teens: Family is the hardest place to practise what you believe, because nobody there is impressed by you. It is also where it counts most.

verse: Be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other.

step.kids: Do a job at home before you are asked.
step.teens: Say the apology you have been avoiding at home.

title: SOCIAL MEDIA

hook.kids: Screens are fun. They are not your whole life.
hook.teens: Comparison, performance, and the version of you that lives online.

body.kids: What you see on a screen is only the good bits people chose to show.
body.teens: You are comparing your inside to everyone else's edit. That is not a fair fight, and no amount of scrolling will make it one.

verse: Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind.

step.kids: Have one hour today with no screen.
step.teens: Unfollow three accounts that consistently make you feel worse.

title: IDENTITY

hook.teens: Who you are when nobody is watching, and who tells you what you are worth.

body.kids: You are not a mistake. God knew you before anyone else did.
body.teens: Everyone is being handed an identity by something — a school, a feed, a friendship group. Scripture's claim is that yours was given before any of them had an opinion.

verse: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made.

step.kids: Tell someone one thing you like about them.
step.teens: Name the voice you have been letting define you, and hold it up against what God says.

title: PURPOSE

hook.kids: God has good things for you to do.
hook.teens: What your life is actually for, when nobody has told you yet.

body.kids: You do not have to wait until you are grown up to do good things.
body.teens: Purpose in the Bible is rarely a career. It is a direction: love God, love people, and do the next right thing in front of you.

verse: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works.

step.kids: Do one good thing for someone today.
step.teens: Do the next right thing in front of you this week, and stop waiting for a calling.

title: RELATIONSHIPS

hook.kids: Being kind to everyone, including people you do not like.
hook.teens: Liking someone, being liked, and not losing yourself in it.

body.kids: Treat everyone the way you would want to be treated.
body.teens: Someone who is good for you makes you more like the person you want to be, not less. Anyone who needs you smaller is not offering love.

verse: Love is patient and is kind.

step.kids: Be kind to someone who is often left out.
step.teens: Ask yourself honestly whether the people closest to you make you kinder.
